tech_about.title: Exchange, offline, and a guarantor who holds nothing
tech_about.info: The payment layer is only the floor. The same primitives give currency exchange, offline payments and a free escrow.
tech_about.p1: Exchange up to 255 currencies — atomic swaps, liquidity pools that clear a whole batch at a single price, and fiat staking. Payments work with no internet too: two phones exchange signed QR codes offline.
tech_about.p2: A pool of three — buyer, seller, guarantor — turns any two signatures into a majority. The guarantor freezes no money and can't steal alone: he'd need a second signature from the very party he set out to rob. Classic escrow charges 1–5% to hold your money; here no one holds it.

about.title: Money, without the middlemen
about.info: XyncPay lets anyone send, request and exchange money across borders at the best rate, with 0% fee — built on the Xync Network, a minimalist L1 where a payment is final in about 0.3 seconds.
about.det_p1: XyncPay is a payment app, not a crypto zoo. It does three things — move money to any country, collect money with a payment request, and exchange between 255 currencies — and it does them with no accounts on exchanges and no hidden fees.
about.det_p2: Under the hood runs the Xync Network: a phone-light L1 that finalizes a transfer in one network round-trip, keeps the whole payment in an 80-byte message, and can even settle offline over QR codes.
about.values_content: Xync solves the blockchain trilemma for one narrow domain — money. Security comes from BFT quorums and fraud proofs, scale from a fastpath that skips consensus and whose latency doesn't grow with load, and decentralization from an open, dynamic validator set anyone can join.
about.value2: Runs on a phone — even offline
about.value3: Open validator set, verifiable by anyone
